## What's free

$30/month compute credit on the Starter plan (CPU and GPU, serverless containers); no card required

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://modal.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Infrastructure is defined in Modal's Python SDK; there is no Terraform provider.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
